basic_details.job_title: Araria Civil Court Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk, Peon/Orderly Posts
basic_details.short_information: Three support staff posts in the Evening Court, Araria – one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly – are to be filled on a contractual basis, and only eligible retired employees of the Civil Court may apply. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Araria on or before 16 December 2026, either personally or through registered post. The notice was issued on 25 November 2026 under Memo No. 1996-2037/Admn.

content_sections.heading: About Araria Civil Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Araria, which heads the Araria Judgeship in Bihar. The engagement is for support staff in the Evening Court of the Araria Judgeship, and the terms follow the directions and guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Copies of the notice have been sent to all Principal District & Sessions Judges of Bihar for display on their notice boards, and to the sub-divisional court, Forbesganj.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the following office on or before 16 December 2026: Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Araria Mode: either personally (by hand) or through registered post. The deadline is for receipt: the application must reach the office by 16.12.2026. The notice does not prescribe an application form, an envelope superscription or a list of enclosures.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the last three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. The applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the three posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post. No remuneration amount is printed in the notice. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Araria Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in the Evening Court, Araria: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Araria on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Araria Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, may apply. They must have satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Deliver the application personally or send it by registered post to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Araria, so that it reaches by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q6. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Araria Evening Court job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, and gives no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q9. How will the remuneration be decided?
faq.answer: The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.
